verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP capability list names searching emails with custom queries and filtering by labels, so basic query search and label filters exist. That is a single prose bullet with no schema, and nothing covers search speed, query operators, result ranking, or reach across the full mail history. missing for 10: documented search operators/syntax, ranked results, search performance claims or benchmarks, coverage of full mail history, in-app search UI docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history
